feeds.title: Beagles and Books » Picture Books
feeds.description: Hi! I am Laura Mossa. I am an elementary reading specialist in Baltimore County. My goal is to build a community of readers at my school. Beagles and Books were created because, in addition to books, I love my sweet beagles.

feeds.title: Beagle in Mind Blog
feeds.description: Beagle in Mind is a trust established to support the education of the Beagle breed for families, adoptive owners, those interested in owning a Beagle and foster volunteers.

feeds.title: Dear Goddamned Dog
feeds.description: Dear Goddamned Dog is a collection of letters to my dogs, in which I reason with them and they ignore me. This blog is dedicated to my dogs, and to all the humans having perfectly rational discussions with their dogs every day.

feeds.title: Life With Beagle
feeds.description: Writer Christie Zizo and Lulu bring you the latest in doggy trends, lifestyle, health, rescue, advocacy, and travel, sometimes with a beagle twist. A pet lifestyle and news blog from the perspective of a first-time beagle owner.

feeds.title: The Barmy Beagle Blog
feeds.description: Provides reliable information and entertaining content on all things relating to the beagle breed, fun facts, best beagle-proof products and more all in one place! The Barmy Beagle is dedicated to barmy beagles and their equally crazy owners!

feeds.title: OMG Beagle Blog
feeds.description: Discover helpful Beagle Care & Training tips and insights. OMG Beagle helps beagle lovers connect with other beagle lovers with a common pride and joy that only a beagle owner can have. This is achieved through their collection of cute, funny gifts for beagle lovers and their adorable furry beagle friends.
